_doc: Styles of the centers agent (Pokémon Center 1F/2F, gTileset_Building + gTileset_PokemonCenter). Black 2 map textures only (src = a/0/1/4 texture set; each texture's palette is <tex>_pl in its set). Sapphire's Center: cream floor tiles with a dotted grid, orange plank walls (also the 2F pillars), an orange door mat.

center._doc: Floor b01_yuka (set 282: a cream tile with a darker edge, one per tile = 16 units, for Sapphire's cream tile grid); wall in76en_kabe1 (set 378: orange vertical panels over a red skirting, for Sapphire's orange plank wall; 16x32 texels over the 50-unit wall, u_size 25 keeps the texels square); entrance in02_yuka6 (set 283: Black 2's own Pokémon Center floor) fading to black; black caps from the Center's own set 283
